title: Decision-tree predictions guide synthesis of a cadmium-copper-antimony Laves phase
summary: A decision-tree classifier trained on known intermetallic structures guided experiments on cadmium-copper-antimony compositions. The researchers synthesized a limited antimony-substitution range adopting the cubic MgCu 2-type Laves structure, supported by diffraction and elemental measurements. This is a measured structural finding; predictions for more than 400000 other candidates are not experimental discoveries, and the classifier also produced false positives.
organization: University of Alberta; Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur

evidence.tested: Primary supporting tables compare model predictions with experimental phase outcomes, including CdCu 1.8 Sb 0.2; diffraction patterns and elemental analysis support the synthesized limited solid-solution range.
evidence.unknown: Functional material performance and broad predicted-candidate validity are unestablished. Nominal and measured compositions differ slightly; the optimized model predicts some compositions that did not form the target phase.
evidence.ai_role: A decision tree learned structure classes from about 3700 known AB 2 phases using elemental descriptors, predicted candidate compositions and guided experimental targeting of the cadmium-copper-antimony system.

source_review.scope: Primary publisher article-front metadata and abstract, complete official author supporting information Methods/model tables/experimental characterizations and result captions, and current PubMed notice metadata. Paywalled main article body was not read; no independent replication performed.
